immigration.text: Hernandez lists defending immigrants, protecting them against ICE, and upholding sanctuary principles among his campaign priorities.
immigration.quote: defending immigrants and our communities, Victor is putting the needs of California's working families and small businesses above corporate greed

health.text: Hernandez calls health care a human right and lists enacting the single-payer CalCare bill and statewide free clinics among his priorities.
health.quote: Healthcare is a human right, and everyone deserves access to quality care that meets their needs without bankrupting them.
